title: Online BCA in Database Administration | DSU Online Elective
description: Explore Database Administration in DSU’s Online BCA. Learn DBMS, SQL, database design, and management skills for careers in data and IT administration. Join now.

blocks.x: database design | SQL tuning | backup & recovery | DB security | performance monitoring

This elective equips you with skills to design, manage, secure, and optimize enterprise-level relational databases. It is unique because: You will gain hands-on expertise in SQL tuning, backup & recovery, database security, managing user permissions, and performance monitoring. It prepares you for operational IT roles highly valued in enterprise environments, making you job-ready as a Database Administrator, SQL Analyst, or Technical Support Engineer with a database focus.
Learn how to model, structure, and normalize relational databases for optimal performance and maintainability.
Optimize SQL queries, indexes, and database performance to handle large-scale enterprise workloads efficiently.
Implement user permissions, encryption, and best practices to safeguard data and prevent unauthorized access.
Learn strategies to backup, restore, and recover databases to ensure business continuity in case of failures.
Monitor database performance, detect bottlenecks, and troubleshoot issues to maintain system reliability.
Design, configure, and maintain relational databases to ensure data integrity, security, and high availability.
Perform advanced SQL queries, analyze database performance, optimize queries, and generate actionable insights for business teams.
Provide database troubleshooting, monitor performance metrics, implement backup/recovery solutions, and assist end-users with database issues.
Manage user permissions, enforce security policies, and monitor database access to prevent unauthorized activities.
Monitor database performance, detect bottlenecks, implement tuning measures, and ensure smooth day-to-day database operations.
